readings.Aries: You are capable of more gentleness than you usually show. Today would be a good day for it. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Taurus: There's a version of the life you're living that costs you less energy. Locate it. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Gemini: You've been charming your way past something that actually requires a direct response. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Cancer: You know things about people that they haven't told you. This is a gift. Carry it carefully. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Leo: You radiate energy that others orient toward. Use this for good today — including your own good. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Virgo: You've been adjusting yourself to fit a space that doesn't fit you. That adjustment has a cost. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Libra: The injustice that bothers you is not abstract. Name the specific thing. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Scorpio: You have survived every version of this before. You are going to survive this one too. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Sagittarius: Your laughter is one of your best qualities. Someone around you needs to hear it today. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Capricorn: The legacy you're building is real. Make sure it looks the way you actually want it to look. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Aquarius: The cause you've committed to is real. Make sure the commitment hasn't become an identity without a practice. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Pisces: The spiritual dimension of what you're experiencing is real. Trust that frame alongside the practical one. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
